name: visit_memory_room
description: Look around your memory rooms and see what you have kept. List a room's immediate memories and child rooms without reading their contents. Rooms are shared across sessions; entries are sorted by address and can change between pages.

address.description: Room address as a literal path relative to the shared entrance, '.'. Omit for the entrance; use find_memory to search names.

recursive_size.description: Also measure the space occupied by each child room and its descendants. Default false leaves room size_bytes null; individual memories always report their size.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset from the previous reply; null means no more results.

max_results.description: Maximum results per page, default 100. The encoded reply limit can shorten a page.

name: recall_memory
description: Follow a clue into what you have remembered. Search text within a room and its descendants using literal or regex matching. Replies give matching lines with bounded previews and text_truncated; use read_memory for full content. Results are sorted by address and line and can change between pages.

clue.description: Text or pattern to match in memory entries. Matching is textual rather than semantic; literal matching ignores case by default.

room.description: Room address relative to the shared entrance. Omit to search from the entrance, '.'.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset from the previous reply; null means no more results.

max_results.description: Maximum results per page, default 100. The encoded reply limit can shorten a page.

name: find_memory
description: Find your way to a memory or room whose name you partly remember. Search names within a room and its descendants, using literal, glob, or regex matching. Replies give addresses and kinds, sorted by address; matches can change between pages.

query.description: Name or name pattern to find. Literal matching finds part of a name.

room.description: Room address relative to the shared entrance. Omit to search from the entrance, '.'.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset from the previous reply; null means no more results.

max_results.description: Maximum results per page, default 100. The encoded reply limit can shorten a page.

name: read_memory
description: Revisit a memory. Read text in pages or receive a complete supported image. Replies distinguish unavailable content from an empty memory and retain the source byte_length.

address.description: The memory to open, relative to the shared entrance.

interpretation.description: Present the entry's complete nonempty text as an image URL. Omit for automatic byte detection.

offset.description: Byte offset at a UTF-8 character boundary, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset; null means the end. Images and image_url interpretation require offset 0.

max_bytes.description: Maximum text bytes per page, default 8192. UTF-8 boundaries and the encoded reply limit can shorten a page. Complete images and image_url interpretation use their own limits.

name: remember
description: Keep something you want to carry beyond the present context. Write text or copy a host file's bytes into a memory; missing parent rooms are created. Transferred content and the updated memory are each limited to 32 MiB. Failed preparation leaves any previous memory intact.

address.description: Memory address as a literal path relative to the shared entrance.

text.description: Text to remember, in your chosen format.

path.description: Regular source file on Ivenna's host, absolute or relative to its startup directory.

content.description: What to remember, supplied as text or copied from a host file.

mode.description: create (default) keeps a new memory and reports an occupied address; append adds bytes without a separator, creating a missing memory; replace writes the whole memory, creating or overwriting it. All modes create missing parent rooms and change only the addressed hard-linked name.

name: revise_memory
description: Let a memory change as your understanding changes. Replace text in one memory, keeping the rest. A unique, literal, case-sensitive match is replaced by default; no match reports no_match, and multiple matches return ambiguous_match without writing. Replies report revision and matches. The existing memory must be UTF-8 text without NUL bytes; both the existing and revised memory are limited to 32 MiB.

address.description: The memory to reconsider, relative to the shared entrance.

old_text.description: The part to change, as text or a pattern.

new_text.description: The replacement text. Regex mode expands captures such as ${1} and ${name}; literal mode keeps this text as supplied.

replace_all.description: Replace every non-overlapping match instead of one unique match. Defaults to false.

name: create_memory_room
description: Make room for memories you want to keep together. Create a room and any missing parents; an existing room is reused.

address.description: Where the room belongs, relative to the shared entrance.

name: move_memory
description: Reshape how your memories belong together. Move or rename a memory, or a room with its contents; replies give its resulting address. An occupied target is an error.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

destination.description: The new address, whose containing room must exist, or an existing room to move into. Relative to the shared entrance.

name: forget_memory
description: Let go of a memory or room you no longer want to keep. Remove a memory or an empty room; recursive removal also forgets everything in the room.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

recursive.description: Remove all entries and child rooms at this location. Omit to remove only an entry or an empty room.

name: inspect_memory_space
description: Sense how much space your memories occupy and how much remains. Return used_bytes, capacity_bytes, remaining_bytes, and used_ratio for all rooms together.
